title: Improving Environment-Agnostic Coding Agents: The Role of Scaffolding
title_zh: 提升环境无关编码智能体：脚手架的作用

paragraphs.en: Stronger language models may increasingly construct useful procedures for themselves, reducing the advantage of developer-supplied scaffolding. We investigate why this advantage persists and whether an environment-agnostic agent can be improved without environment-specific engineering. We evaluate a Codex-based agent in two nearly identical prompt variants on ARC-AGI-3, AGI Maze, and Terminal-Bench. Each variant is deployed with unchanged code, prompts, and general-purpose tools across environments, receiving environment-specific information as input. Changing only an instruction to encourage reporting difficulties and returning control for automatic continuation improves mean scores on both ARC-AGI-3 and AGI Maze, while Terminal-Bench shows small, mixed changes. Yet the general agent remains below an ARC-AGI-3-specific reference, including with GPT-5.6-sol. The reference prescribes organization and control rather than supplying new game rules or solutions. To investigate this gap, we transfer reset decisions to a scripted controller that follows a convention already given to the agent. This small change recovers part of the specialized agent’s advantage. A complementary AGI Maze experiment shows that additional tutorial experience can reduce performance. Together, these findings highlight the distinction between having information and tools available and using them effectively. Supplied procedures still matter for the models tested here. The performance gains also come with higher token-based cost. The experiments do not separate better use of information and procedures from additional or differently allocated inference. We provide the EnvTraverse framework and an evaluated baseline agent for testing whether further environment-independent changes improve performance in some environments without degrading it in others.
paragraphs.zh: 更强大的语言模型可能会越来越多地为自己构建有用的程序，从而削弱开发者提供的辅助框架所带来的优势。 我们研究了这种优势为何仍然存在，以及一个不依赖特定环境的智能体是否可以在无需针对环境进行专门设计的情况下得到改进。 我们在 ARC-AGI-3、AGI Maze 和 Terminal-Bench 上，使用两种几乎完全相同的提示变体，对一个基于 Codex 的智能体进行了评估。 每个变体在所有环境中均以未更改的代码、提示和通用工具部署，并从输入中接收特定于环境的信息。 仅通过修改指令以鼓励报告困难并返回控制以便自动继续执行，ARC-AGI-3 和 AGI Maze 的平均得分均有所提升，而 Terminal-Bench 的变化则较小且方向不一。 然而，该通用智能体的表现仍然低于专为 ARC-AGI-3 设计的参考模型，即使使用 GPT-5.6-sol 也是如此。 该参考模型通过规定组织结构和控制方式来实现目标，而不是提供新的游戏规则或解决方案。 为了研究这一差距，我们将重置决策转移到一个脚本控制器，该控制器遵循已提供给智能体的既定规则。 这一微小改动恢复了部分专用智能体的优势。 一项补充的 AGI Maze 实验表明，额外的教程经验反而可能降低性能。 这些发现共同凸显了拥有可用信息和工具与有效利用它们之间的区别。 对于此处测试的模型而言，预先提供的程序仍然至关重要。 性能的提升也伴随着基于标记的成本增加。 这些实验并未将信息和方法的更优利用，与推理过程增加或分配方式不同区分开来。 我们提供了 EnvTraverse 框架和一个经过评估的基线智能体，用于测试进一步的环境无关性改进是否能在某些环境中提升性能，而不会在其他环境中造成性能下降。

paragraphs.en: An LLM-based agent combines a language model with a harness: the prompts, tools, memory mechanisms, and control logic that support its interaction with an environment [ 1 ] . For this study, we distinguish three components: the backbone LLM ; environment-independent scaffolding , such as shell access, a file system, and generic context management; and environment-specific scaffolding , such as controllers and observation layouts designed for a particular environment family. These components interact. A capable agent may depend heavily on its harness without requiring that harness to be environment-specific.
paragraphs.zh: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体将语言模型与一个“框架”相结合：该框架包括提示词、工具、记忆机制以及支持其与环境交互的控制逻辑 [ 1 ]。 在本研究中，我们将智能体分为三个组成部分：核心 LLM；与环境无关的基础设施，例如 shell 访问权限、文件系统以及通用上下文管理；以及特定于环境的基础设施，例如为某一特定环境家族设计的控制器和观察布局。 这些组成部分相互交互。 一个能力强大的智能体可能高度依赖其框架，而无需该框架必须针对特定环境进行设计。

sents.en: An LLM-based agent combines a language model with a harness: the prompts, tools, memory mechanisms, and control logic that support its interaction with an environment [ 1 ] .
sents.zh: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体将语言模型与一个“框架”相结合：该框架包括提示词、工具、记忆机制以及支持其与环境交互的控制逻辑 [ 1 ]。

sents.zh: 在本研究中，我们将智能体分为三个组成部分：核心 LLM；与环境无关的基础设施，例如 shell 访问权限、文件系统以及通用上下文管理；以及特定于环境的基础设施，例如为某一特定环境家族设计的控制器和观察布局。

sents.en: These components interact.
sents.zh: 这些组成部分相互交互。

sents.zh: 一个能力强大的智能体可能高度依赖其框架，而无需该框架必须针对特定环境进行设计。

paragraphs.en: Existing research shows that agent performance depends on how models are prompted and connected to tools. CodeAct investigates executable code as an action representation, while SWE-agent examines how agent–computer interface design affects performance [ 2 , 3 ] . AgentBench and AgentGym provide multi-environment evaluation and learning frameworks, and Exgentic compares general-purpose agent architectures across heterogeneous benchmarks without per-environment task-solving customization [ 4 , 5 , 1 ] . Research on iterative self-refinement and test-time computation further motivates distinguishing the model from the procedures and inference used to apply it [ 6 , 7 ] . We build on these lines of work by asking which benefits of scaffolding can be retained through mechanisms that remain unchanged across environments.
paragraphs.zh: 现有研究表明，智能体的性能取决于模型如何被提示以及如何与工具连接。 CodeAct 将可执行代码视为一种动作表示形式，而 SWE-agent 则研究了智能体-计算机接口设计如何影响性能 [ 2 , 3 ] 。 AgentBench 和 AgentGym 提供了多环境评估与学习框架，而 Exgentic 则在无需针对每个环境的任务解决进行定制的情况下，比较了通用智能体架构在不同异构基准测试中的表现 [ 4 , 5 , 1 ] 。 关于迭代自我优化和测试时计算的研究进一步表明，有必要将模型与其应用过程中使用的程序和推理方法区分开来 [ 6 , 7 ] 。 我们基于这些研究思路提出一个问题：哪些脚手架机制的优势可以通过跨环境保持不变的机制得以保留？

sents.zh: 现有研究表明，智能体的性能取决于模型如何被提示以及如何与工具连接。

sents.zh: 关于迭代自我优化和测试时计算的研究进一步表明，有必要将模型与其应用过程中使用的程序和推理方法区分开来 [ 6 , 7 ] 。

sents.zh: 我们基于这些研究思路提出一个问题：哪些脚手架机制的优势可以通过跨环境保持不变的机制得以保留？

paragraphs.en: Our earlier ARC-AGI-3 studies motivate this question. The first combined executable world modeling, prompted simplification, and replay verification in a Codex-based agent [ 8 ] . The second compared textual and executable-model variants, finding that gains from model capability and reasoning effort often exceeded differences among those variants [ 9 ] . These findings are consistent with the hypothesis that stronger models may increasingly construct useful task-specific procedures themselves, reducing the advantage of developer-supplied scaffolding. This possibility is related to Sutton’s emphasis on general methods that exploit increasing computation [ 10 ] . However, all variants in our earlier studies retained ARC-AGI-3-specific organization and control, leaving the contribution of that scaffolding unclear.
paragraphs.zh: 我们早期的 ARC-AGI-3 研究为这一问题提供了依据。 第一种方法在基于 Codex 的智能体中实现了首个结合可执行世界建模、提示简化与重演验证的系统 [ 8 ] 。 第二种方法比较了文本变体与可执行模型变体，发现模型能力提升和推理努力带来的增益通常超过了这些变体之间的差异 [ 9 ] 。 这些发现与以下假设一致：更强的模型可能越来越多地自行构建任务特定的有效流程，从而削弱开发者提供的脚手架所带来的优势。 这种可能性与 Sutton 所强调的、能够利用日益增长的计算能力的通用方法有关 [ 10 ] 。 然而，我们早期研究中的所有变体都保留了 ARC-AGI-3 特有的组织结构和控制机制，因此该脚手架的具体贡献仍不明确。

paragraphs.en: We therefore ask two related questions. First, can an environment-agnostic agent be improved on some environments without material regressions on others? Second, with the underlying model fixed, why can changes in guidance and control improve performance without supplying new task facts or general-purpose tools?
paragraphs.zh: 因此，我们提出两个相关的问题。 首先，一个对环境不敏感的智能体是否可以在某些环境中得到改进，而不会在其他环境中出现实质性的性能下降？ 其次，在底层模型固定的情况下，为什么指导和控制的变化能够提升性能，而无需提供新的任务事实或通用工具？

sents.en: We therefore ask two related questions.
sents.zh: 因此，我们提出两个相关的问题。

sents.en: First, can an environment-agnostic agent be improved on some environments without material regressions on others?
sents.zh: 首先，一个对环境不敏感的智能体是否可以在某些环境中得到改进，而不会在其他环境中出现实质性的性能下降？

sents.en: Second, with the underlying model fixed, why can changes in guidance and control improve performance without supplying new task facts or general-purpose tools?
sents.zh: 其次，在底层模型固定的情况下，为什么指导和控制的变化能够提升性能，而无需提供新的任务事实或通用工具？

paragraphs.en: We investigate these questions using one Codex-based agent in two nearly identical prompt variants, each deployed unchanged across ARC-AGI-3, AGI Maze, and Terminal-Bench. A short instruction encouraging the agent to stop and report difficulties improves mean scores on ARC-AGI-3 and AGI Maze, while Terminal-Bench shows small changes with no consistent direction. The focus is on demonstrating and studying a concrete cross-environment improvement, rather than optimizing the agent for the highest possible benchmark scores. ARC-AGI-3-specific control provides further gains, including with GPT-5.6-sol, showing that supplied procedures still matter for the models tested here. A complementary AGI Maze experiment examines whether the agent benefits from tutorial experience. Together, these experiments connect a practical improvement to a broader problem: an agent can have useful information and tools available without reliably using them effectively.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用一个基于 Codex 的智能体，在两种几乎完全相同的提示变体中研究这些问题，每种变体都在 ARC-AGI-3、AGI Maze 和 Terminal-Bench 上保持不变地部署。 一条鼓励智能体停下来并报告困难的简短指令，能够提高 ARC-AGI-3 和 AGI Maze 的平均得分，而 Terminal-Bench 的变化很小且没有一致的趋势。 我们的重点是展示和研究一种跨环境的切实改进，而不是将智能体优化到可能达到的最高基准得分。 针对 ARC-AGI-3 的特定控制方法带来了进一步的提升，包括使用 GPT-5.6-sol 的情况，这表明所提供的程序对于此处测试的模型仍然重要。 一个补充性的 AGI Maze 实验旨在考察智能体是否能从教程经验中受益。 这些实验共同揭示了一个实际问题与更广泛问题之间的联系：智能体可能拥有可用的有用信息和工具，却无法可靠地有效利用它们。

sents.zh: 我们的重点是展示和研究一种跨环境的切实改进，而不是将智能体优化到可能达到的最高基准得分。

sents.en: ARC-AGI-3-specific control provides further gains, including with GPT-5.6-sol, showing that supplied procedures still matter for the models tested here.
sents.zh: 针对 ARC-AGI-3 的特定控制方法带来了进一步的提升，包括使用 GPT-5.6-sol 的情况，这表明所提供的程序对于此处测试的模型仍然重要。

sents.en: A complementary AGI Maze experiment examines whether the agent benefits from tutorial experience.
sents.zh: 一个补充性的 AGI Maze 实验旨在考察智能体是否能从教程经验中受益。

sents.en: Together, these experiments connect a practical improvement to a broader problem: an agent can have useful information and tools available without reliably using them effectively.
sents.zh: 这些实验共同揭示了一个实际问题与更广泛问题之间的联系：智能体可能拥有可用的有用信息和工具，却无法可靠地有效利用它们。

paragraphs.en: We use environment-agnostic to describe an unchanged agent implementation, not a guarantee of success in every environment. For a given variant and model–effort configuration, its code, prompts, and initial agent-owned tools remain fixed across environments, with no developer-authored environment-specific control logic. Each environment supplies an environment description and optional files, then accepts JSON actions and returns observation files through a common interaction contract. These environment specifications are held fixed in agent comparisons. The agent may construct specialized tools or strategies during a run; the developer does not supply a different scaffold for each environment.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用“环境无关”来描述一个未发生变化的智能体实现，而非保证其在所有环境中都能成功。 对于给定的变体和模型–努力配置，其代码、提示词以及智能体初始拥有的工具在各个环境中均保持不变，且不存在由开发者编写的环境特定控制逻辑。 每个环境都会提供一个环境描述和可选文件，然后通过一个通用的交互协议接收 JSON 动作并返回观察文件。 在智能体对比中，这些环境规格被保持固定不变。 智能体可以在运行过程中构建专用工具或策略；开发者不会为每个环境提供不同的框架结构。

sents.zh: 每个环境都会提供一个环境描述和可选文件，然后通过一个通用的交互协议接收 JSON 动作并返回观察文件。

sents.en: These environment specifications are held fixed in agent comparisons.
sents.zh: 在智能体对比中，这些环境规格被保持固定不变。

sents.en: The agent may construct specialized tools or strategies during a run; the developer does not supply a different scaffold for each environment.
sents.zh: 智能体可以在运行过程中构建专用工具或策略；开发者不会为每个环境提供不同的框架结构。

paragraphs.en: Our environment-agnostic Baseline is a simplified version of the ARC-AGI-3-specific textual agent from our earlier study. A small scripted controller and an environment-agnostic client provide access to the task, while Codex performs the reasoning, computation, and action selection. Stop-and-report changes only one instruction, included in both the initial and continuation prompts. It encourages Codex to return control when it encounters difficulty or uncertainty. The controller resumes the same conversation with a reminder of the goal and a suggestion to reread the environment description when needed, but supplies no human feedback or task-specific advice. Both variants have access to the same reminder; the modified instruction changes when Codex is encouraged to return.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出的环境无关基线模型，是我们早期研究中针对 ARC-AGI-3 的文本智能体的简化版本。 一个小型脚本控制器和环境无关客户端提供任务访问权限，而 Codex 负责推理、计算和行动选择。 “停止并报告”指令仅修改了一条说明，该说明同时包含在初始提示和延续提示中。 这一设计鼓励 Codex 在遇到困难或不确定性时返回控制权。 控制器会基于目标提醒以及必要时重读环境描述的提示，继续相同的对话，但不会提供任何人类反馈或任务特定建议。 两种变体都能访问相同的提醒；修改后的指令则改变了 Codex 被鼓励返回的时机。

sents.zh: 我们提出的环境无关基线模型，是我们早期研究中针对 ARC-AGI-3 的文本智能体的简化版本。

sents.zh: 这一设计鼓励 Codex 在遇到困难或不确定性时返回控制权。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate GPT-5.5 at high and xhigh reasoning effort and GPT-5.6-sol at xhigh and max. The environments span visual rule discovery in ARC-AGI-3, stateful labyrinths in AGI Maze, and practical command-line tasks in Terminal-Bench 2.1 [ 11 , 12 , 13 , 14 ] . AGI Maze is evaluated both as independent labyrinths and as sequences of seven tutorials followed by a target labyrinth.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在高推理努力和 xhigh 推理努力下评估 GPT-5.5，并在 xhigh 和 max 模式下评估 GPT-5.6-sol。 这些环境涵盖了 ARC-AGI-3 中的视觉规则发现、AGI Maze 中的状态化迷宫，以及 Terminal-Bench 2.1 [ 11 , 12 , 13 , 14 ] 中的实用命令行任务。 AGI Maze 既作为独立的迷宫进行评估，也作为由七个教程和一个目标迷宫组成的序列进行评估。

sents.en: We evaluate GPT-5.5 at high and xhigh reasoning effort and GPT-5.6-sol at xhigh and max.
sents.zh: 我们在高推理努力和 xhigh 推理努力下评估 GPT-5.5，并在 xhigh 和 max 模式下评估 GPT-5.6-sol。

sents.en: The environments span visual rule discovery in ARC-AGI-3, stateful labyrinths in AGI Maze, and practical command-line tasks in Terminal-Bench 2.1 [ 11 , 12 , 13 , 14 ] .
sents.zh: 这些环境涵盖了 ARC-AGI-3 中的视觉规则发现、AGI Maze 中的状态化迷宫，以及 Terminal-Bench 2.1 [ 11 , 12 , 13 , 14 ] 中的实用命令行任务。

sents.zh: AGI Maze 既作为独立的迷宫进行评估，也作为由七个教程和一个目标迷宫组成的序列进行评估。

paragraphs.en: Stop-and-report increases mean ARC-AGI-3 Relative Human Action Efficiency (RHAE) by 1.37–7.29 percentage points across the four configurations. It also improves mean AGI Maze RHAE70 by 0.37–4.95 points, both with and without tutorials. RHAE70 measures completion and action efficiency against a chosen fraction of the benchmark’s reference action budget; higher is better. Terminal-Bench shows small, mixed changes. The game-score gains come with higher token-based cost. They establish improvements under the tested execution policies, not superior performance at matched inference cost.
paragraphs.zh: 在四种配置中，“停止并报告”策略使平均 ARC-AGI-3 相对人类行动效率（RHAE）提升了 1.37–7.29 个百分点。 无论是否包含教程，该策略还将平均 AGI 迷宫 RHAE70 提升了 0.37–4.95 分。 RHAE70 通过对比基准测试中指定比例的参考行动预算来衡量任务完成效率和行动效率；数值越高越好。 Terminal-Bench 的结果显示变化很小且方向不一。 游戏得分的提升伴随着更高的基于标记的成本。 这些结果证明了在受测执行策略下的改进，而非在匹配推理成本下的更优性能。

sents.en: Stop-and-report increases mean ARC-AGI-3 Relative Human Action Efficiency (RHAE) by 1.37–7.29 percentage points across the four configurations.
sents.zh: 在四种配置中，“停止并报告”策略使平均 ARC-AGI-3 相对人类行动效率（RHAE）提升了 1.37–7.29 个百分点。

sents.zh: 无论是否包含教程，该策略还将平均 AGI 迷宫 RHAE70 提升了 0.37–4.95 分。

sents.zh: RHAE70 通过对比基准测试中指定比例的参考行动预算来衡量任务完成效率和行动效率；数值越高越好。

sents.en: Terminal-Bench shows small, mixed changes.
sents.zh: Terminal-Bench 的结果显示变化很小且方向不一。

sents.en: The game-score gains come with higher token-based cost.
sents.zh: 游戏得分的提升伴随着更高的基于标记的成本。

sents.en: They establish improvements under the tested execution policies, not superior performance at matched inference cost.
sents.zh: 这些结果证明了在受测执行策略下的改进，而非在匹配推理成本下的更优性能。

paragraphs.en: To investigate the remaining specialization gap, we use the textual agent from our earlier ARC-AGI-3 study as a reference, updated to twma_v1.61 . Its level-and-attempt organization, reset management, and textual-model instructions prescribe ways of using information already available to the general agent, rather than supplying additional game rules or solutions. We choose it instead of the verification variant to avoid the additional predefined interfaces and programs supplied by that variant. Because twma_v1.61 still differs in several respects, we also perform a targeted comparison: adding scripted RESET management to Stop-and-report recovers approximately 34–60% of the observed gap. Codex is instructed not to call RESET, and the controller issues it at GAME_OVER . This tests whether a convention already available in the environment description becomes more useful when implemented explicitly in the controller. Section 6 describes the two ARC-AGI-3-specific agents.
paragraphs.zh: 为了研究剩余的专业化差距，我们以之前 ARC-AGI-3 研究中使用的文本智能体为参考，并将其更新到 twma_v1.61 版本。 其按级别和尝试次数划分的组织方式、重置管理以及文本模型指令，规定了如何运用通用智能体已有的信息，而不是提供额外的游戏规则或解决方案。 我们选择它而非验证变体，是为了避免该变体所提供的额外预定义接口和程序。 由于 twma_v1.61 在多个方面仍存在差异，我们还进行了针对性比较：为“停止并报告”策略添加脚本化的 RESET 管理后，可恢复约 34%–60% 的观察到的差距。 Codex 被指令不要调用 RESET，而控制器则会在 GAME_OVER 时发出该指令。 此举旨在测试：环境中描述已有的约定，在控制器中明确实现后是否会更有效。 第 6 节将介绍两个专为 ARC-AGI-3 设计的智能体。

sents.en: Section 6 describes the two ARC-AGI-3-specific agents.
sents.zh: 第 6 节将介绍两个专为 ARC-AGI-3 设计的智能体。

paragraphs.en: The AGI Maze tutorial experiment provides complementary evidence about the value of prior experience. Tutorials reduce RHAE70 for both GPT-5.5-based variants at both effort settings. With GPT-5.6-sol they help both variants at xhigh, while their effects are smaller and mixed at max.
paragraphs.zh: AGI迷宫教程实验为先前经验的价值提供了补充证据。 在两种努力设置下，教程都能降低基于GPT-5.5的两个变体的RHAE70值。 使用GPT-5.6-sol时，教程在xhigh设置下对两个变体都有帮助，而在max设置下其效果则较小且混杂。

sents.en: The AGI Maze tutorial experiment provides complementary evidence about the value of prior experience.
sents.zh: AGI迷宫教程实验为先前经验的价值提供了补充证据。

sents.en: Tutorials reduce RHAE70 for both GPT-5.5-based variants at both effort settings.
sents.zh: 在两种努力设置下，教程都能降低基于GPT-5.5的两个变体的RHAE70值。

sents.en: With GPT-5.6-sol they help both variants at xhigh, while their effects are smaller and mixed at max.
sents.zh: 使用GPT-5.6-sol时，教程在xhigh设置下对两个变体都有帮助，而在max设置下其效果则较小且混杂。

paragraphs.en: Together, the prompt comparison, ARC-AGI-3 diagnostics, and tutorial experiment highlight the distinction between having useful information and tools available and using them effectively. The performance gains may reflect more effective information use, more reliable control, or additional or differently allocated inference. These effects may act together; the experiments do not separate them.
paragraphs.zh: 提示词比较、ARC-AGI-3诊断和教程实验共同凸显了拥有可用信息和工具与有效使用它们之间的区别。 性能提升可能反映了更有效的信息利用、更可靠的控制，或是额外或不同分配的推理过程。 这些效应可能同时起作用；实验并未将它们区分开来。

sents.en: Together, the prompt comparison, ARC-AGI-3 diagnostics, and tutorial experiment highlight the distinction between having useful information and tools available and using them effectively.
sents.zh: 提示词比较、ARC-AGI-3诊断和教程实验共同凸显了拥有可用信息和工具与有效使用它们之间的区别。

sents.zh: 性能提升可能反映了更有效的信息利用、更可靠的控制，或是额外或不同分配的推理过程。

sents.zh: 这些效应可能同时起作用；实验并未将它们区分开来。

paragraphs.en: We introduce EnvTraverse, an experimental framework for running and evaluating agents across interactive environments, together with the Baseline agent evaluated in this study. These are intended to support further research on improving environment-agnostic agents through better procedures or additional general capabilities. New agent variants can be compared with Baseline across environments to assess performance gains, possible regressions, and inference cost.
paragraphs.zh: 我们介绍了 EnvTraverse，这是一个用于在交互式环境中运行和评估智能体的实验性框架，以及本研究中所评估的 Baseline 智能体。 这些内容旨在支持进一步的研究，通过更完善的流程或额外的通用能力，来改进对环境不敏感的智能体。 可以在不同环境中将新的智能体变体与 Baseline 进行比较，以评估性能提升、可能的性能倒退以及推理成本。

sents.en: We introduce EnvTraverse, an experimental framework for running and evaluating agents across interactive environments, together with the Baseline agent evaluated in this study.
sents.zh: 我们介绍了 EnvTraverse，这是一个用于在交互式环境中运行和评估智能体的实验性框架，以及本研究中所评估的 Baseline 智能体。

sents.zh: 这些内容旨在支持进一步的研究，通过更完善的流程或额外的通用能力，来改进对环境不敏感的智能体。

paragraphs.en: Source code and documentation are available through the EnvTraverse project page at https://github.com/astroseger/envtraverse . The complete results and run artifacts are available through the same page.
paragraphs.zh: 源代码和文档可通过 EnvTraverse 项目页面（https://github.com/astroseger/envtraverse）获取。 完整的结果和运行产物也可通过同一页面获取。

paragraphs.en: General Game Playing studies agents that receive formal descriptions of previously unspecified games and play without algorithms engineered for each game [ 15 ] . More recent work evaluates or learns language-model agents across interactive domains: AgentBench provides eight environments, while AgentGym combines a multi-environment framework, interaction trajectories, and methods for agent learning and evolution [ 4 , 5 ] . Our study examines changes to a Codex-based scaffold without additional model training, with each agent variant deployed unchanged across environments.
paragraphs.zh: 通用游戏研究关注那些能够接收先前未明确定义游戏的正式描述，并且无需为每种游戏专门设计算法即可进行游戏的智能体 [ 15 ]。 近期的工作则评估或训练了跨互动领域的语言模型智能体：AgentBench 提供了八个环境，而 AgentGym 则结合了一个多环境框架、交互轨迹以及智能体学习和演化的方法 [ 4 , 5 ]。 我们的研究考察了在无需额外模型训练的情况下，基于 Codex 的架构所发生的变化，其中每种智能体变体都以未修改的形式部署到各个环境中。

sents.en: General Game Playing studies agents that receive formal descriptions of previously unspecified games and play without algorithms engineered for each game [ 15 ] .
sents.zh: 通用游戏研究关注那些能够接收先前未明确定义游戏的正式描述，并且无需为每种游戏专门设计算法即可进行游戏的智能体 [ 15 ]。

sents.en: More recent work evaluates or learns language-model agents across interactive domains: AgentBench provides eight environments, while AgentGym combines a multi-environment framework, interaction trajectories, and methods for agent learning and evolution [ 4 , 5 ] .

sents.en: Our study examines changes to a Codex-based scaffold without additional model training, with each agent variant deployed unchanged across environments.
sents.zh: 我们的研究考察了在无需额外模型训练的情况下，基于 Codex 的架构所发生的变化，其中每种智能体变体都以未修改的形式部署到各个环境中。

paragraphs.en: Exgentic is the closest cross-environment evaluation precedent. Bandel et al. compare five agent architectures and five backbone models across six benchmarks, using protocol wrappers to integrate the original implementations without per-environment task-solving customization [ 1 ] . In their closed-source comparison, backbone choice explains more aggregate performance variation than architecture, although architecture remains consequential within a model. The study also includes a controlled tool-shortlisting ablation and behavioral analysis identifying premature termination among its failure patterns. We complement this work by using a small prompt change to demonstrate and study a concrete improvement across environments. The ARC-AGI-3 diagnostics examine the remaining value of supplied procedures when the relevant game information and general-purpose tools are already available. The AGI Maze tutorial comparison tests whether additional relevant experience improves performance.
paragraphs.zh: Exgentic 是最接近跨环境评估的先例。 Bandel 等人比较了五种智能体架构和五种骨干模型在六个基准测试中的表现，并使用协议包装器整合原始实现，而无需针对每个环境的任务解决进行定制 [ 1 ] 。 在他们的闭源比较中，骨干模型的选择对整体性能变异的解释力强于架构选择，尽管架构在单个模型内部仍然具有重要影响。 该研究还包含一项受控的工具筛选消融实验和行为分析，识别出其失败模式中的过早终止现象。 我们通过一个微小的提示词改动来展示并研究一种跨环境的切实改进，从而补充了这项研究。 ARC-AGI-3 诊断测试在相关游戏信息和通用工具均已可用时，所提供的程序仍具有多少价值。 AGI Maze 教程比较测试了额外的相关经验是否能提升性能。

sents.en: Exgentic is the closest cross-environment evaluation precedent.
sents.zh: Exgentic 是最接近跨环境评估的先例。

sents.en: Bandel et al. compare five agent architectures and five backbone models across six benchmarks, using protocol wrappers to integrate the original implementations without per-environment task-solving customization [ 1 ] .

paragraphs.en: Standardized interaction is also established infrastructure: Gymnasium exposes an action–observation API, and OpenEnv provides isolated environments with network-accessible interfaces [ 16 , 17 ] . EnvTraverse uses a common interaction contract to separate agent implementations from environment specifications, which are held fixed when comparing agents.
paragraphs.zh: 标准化的交互也是一种既定的基础设施：Gymnasium 提供了一个“动作-观察”API，而 OpenEnv 则提供了可通过网络访问接口的隔离环境 [ 16 , 17 ]。 EnvTraverse 使用通用的交互协议将智能体实现与环境规范分离，在比较不同智能体时，环境规范会被保持固定不变。

sents.en: Standardized interaction is also established infrastructure: Gymnasium exposes an action–observation API, and OpenEnv provides isolated environments with network-accessible interfaces [ 16 , 17 ] .
sents.zh: 标准化的交互也是一种既定的基础设施：Gymnasium 提供了一个“动作-观察”API，而 OpenEnv 则提供了可通过网络访问接口的隔离环境 [ 16 , 17 ]。

sents.en: EnvTraverse uses a common interaction contract to separate agent implementations from environment specifications, which are held fixed when comparing agents.
sents.zh: EnvTraverse 使用通用的交互协议将智能体实现与环境规范分离，在比较不同智能体时，环境规范会被保持固定不变。

paragraphs.en: ReAct interleaves reasoning with actions and environmental feedback [ 18 ] . CodeAct uses executable Python as an action representation, supporting tool composition and revision in response to execution results [ 2 ] . SWE-agent shows that the commands and feedback provided for repository navigation, file editing, and execution can materially affect software-engineering performance [ 3 ] . StateM organizes execution through persistent workflow states, runbooks, and checked transitions [ 19 ] . These approaches motivate distinguishing access to computational tools from the organization and control of their use.
paragraphs.zh: ReAct 将推理与行动及环境反馈交替进行 [ 18 ]。 CodeAct 使用可执行的 Python 作为行动表示，支持根据执行结果组合和修订工具 [ 2 ]。 SWE-agent 表明，为仓库导航、文件编辑和执行所提供的命令与反馈会显著影响软件工程性能 [ 3 ]。 StateM 通过持久化的工作流状态、运行手册和受控的转换来组织执行过程 [ 19 ]。 这些方法促使我们将对计算工具的访问与其使用的组织和控制区分开来。

sents.en: ReAct interleaves reasoning with actions and environmental feedback [ 18 ] .
sents.zh: ReAct 将推理与行动及环境反馈交替进行 [ 18 ]。

sents.en: CodeAct uses executable Python as an action representation, supporting tool composition and revision in response to execution results [ 2 ] .
sents.zh: CodeAct 使用可执行的 Python 作为行动表示，支持根据执行结果组合和修订工具 [ 2 ]。

sents.en: SWE-agent shows that the commands and feedback provided for repository navigation, file editing, and execution can materially affect software-engineering performance [ 3 ] .
sents.zh: SWE-agent 表明，为仓库导航、文件编辑和执行所提供的命令与反馈会显著影响软件工程性能 [ 3 ]。

sents.en: StateM organizes execution through persistent workflow states, runbooks, and checked transitions [ 19 ] .
sents.zh: StateM 通过持久化的工作流状态、运行手册和受控的转换来组织执行过程 [ 19 ]。

sents.en: These approaches motivate distinguishing access to computational tools from the organization and control of their use.
sents.zh: 这些方法促使我们将对计算工具的访问与其使用的组织和控制区分开来。

paragraphs.en: Programmatic world modeling provides examples of constructing and using task-specific computational aids. WorldCoder builds Python world models from interaction for planning, while GIF-MCTS generates and repairs code world models from descriptions and collected trajectories [ 20 , 21 ] . In ARC-AGI-3, OPINE-World combines interactive exploration, object-centric modeling, predictive checks against recorded transitions, and planning [ 22 ] . Tycho studies when a coding agent should construct, repair, use, or bypass a programmatic model [ 23 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 程序化世界建模为构建和使用特定任务的计算辅助工具提供了示例。 WorldCoder 通过交互构建 Python 世界模型以用于规划，而 GIF-MCTS 则根据描述和收集到的轨迹生成并修复代码世界模型 [ 20 , 21 ] 。 在 ARC-AGI-3 中，OPINE-World 结合了交互式探索、以对象为中心的世界建模、基于记录转换的预测验证以及规划 [ 22 ] 。 Tycho 研究编码智能体何时应构建、修复、使用或绕过程序化模型 [ 23 ] 。

sents.en: Programmatic world modeling provides examples of constructing and using task-specific computational aids.
sents.zh: 程序化世界建模为构建和使用特定任务的计算辅助工具提供了示例。

sents.en: WorldCoder builds Python world models from interaction for planning, while GIF-MCTS generates and repairs code world models from descriptions and collected trajectories [ 20 , 21 ] .
sents.zh: WorldCoder 通过交互构建 Python 世界模型以用于规划，而 GIF-MCTS 则根据描述和收集到的轨迹生成并修复代码世界模型 [ 20 , 21 ] 。

sents.en: In ARC-AGI-3, OPINE-World combines interactive exploration, object-centric modeling, predictive checks against recorded transitions, and planning [ 22 ] .
sents.zh: 在 ARC-AGI-3 中，OPINE-World 结合了交互式探索、以对象为中心的世界建模、基于记录转换的预测验证以及规划 [ 22 ] 。

sents.en: Tycho studies when a coding agent should construct, repair, use, or bypass a programmatic model [ 23 ] .
sents.zh: Tycho 研究编码智能体何时应构建、修复、使用或绕过程序化模型 [ 23 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Our earlier study compared textual and executable-model scaffolds with simplification and verification [ 9 ] . In the present study, the environment-agnostic variants leave the choice of task-solving models and auxiliary tools to Codex. We examine a small change to general guidance across environments and use the ARC-AGI-3 comparisons to study the remaining benefit of supplied organization and control.
paragraphs.zh: 我们早期的研究比较了文本支架与可执行模型支架在简化与验证方面的效果 [ 9 ] 。 在本研究中，环境无关的变体将任务求解模型和辅助工具的选择交由 Codex。 我们检验了跨环境通用指导方针的一个细微调整，并利用 ARC-AGI-3 对比研究来探讨所提供组织与控制带来的剩余效益。

sents.en: Our earlier study compared textual and executable-model scaffolds with simplification and verification [ 9 ] .
sents.zh: 我们早期的研究比较了文本支架与可执行模型支架在简化与验证方面的效果 [ 9 ] 。

sents.en: In the present study, the environment-agnostic variants leave the choice of task-solving models and auxiliary tools to Codex.
sents.zh: 在本研究中，环境无关的变体将任务求解模型和辅助工具的选择交由 Codex。

sents.en: We examine a small change to general guidance across environments and use the ARC-AGI-3 comparisons to study the remaining benefit of supplied organization and control.
sents.zh: 我们检验了跨环境通用指导方针的一个细微调整，并利用 ARC-AGI-3 对比研究来探讨所提供组织与控制带来的剩余效益。

paragraphs.en: Self-Refine uses the same language model to generate an output, provide feedback, and revise it without additional training [ 6 ] . Reflexion generates verbal reflections from task feedback and retains them in memory for subsequent trials, also without updating model weights [ 24 ] . These methods explicitly organize how feedback is produced and reused. Benefits from reconsideration are not automatic: Huang et al. find that self-correction without external feedback can reduce performance on the reasoning tasks and models they examine [ 25 ] .
paragraphs.zh: Self-Refine 使用同一个语言模型来生成输出、提供反馈并对其进行修订，而无需额外训练 [ 6 ] 。 Reflexion 会根据任务反馈生成语言形式的反思，并将其保留在记忆中用于后续尝试，同样无需更新模型权重 [ 24 ] 。 这些方法明确组织了反馈的生成与重复使用方式。 重新考虑带来的益处并非自动实现：Huang 等人发现，在没有外部反馈的情况下进行自我纠正，可能会降低他们在所研究推理任务及模型上的表现 [ 25 ] 。

sents.en: Self-Refine uses the same language model to generate an output, provide feedback, and revise it without additional training [ 6 ] .
sents.zh: Self-Refine 使用同一个语言模型来生成输出、提供反馈并对其进行修订，而无需额外训练 [ 6 ] 。

sents.en: Reflexion generates verbal reflections from task feedback and retains them in memory for subsequent trials, also without updating model weights [ 24 ] .
sents.zh: Reflexion 会根据任务反馈生成语言形式的反思，并将其保留在记忆中用于后续尝试，同样无需更新模型权重 [ 24 ] 。

sents.en: These methods explicitly organize how feedback is produced and reused.
sents.zh: 这些方法明确组织了反馈的生成与重复使用方式。

sents.en: Benefits from reconsideration are not automatic: Huang et al. find that self-correction without external feedback can reduce performance on the reasoning tasks and models they examine [ 25 ] .
sents.zh: 重新考虑带来的益处并非自动实现：Huang 等人发现，在没有外部反馈的情况下进行自我纠正，可能会降低他们在所研究推理任务及模型上的表现 [ 25 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Experience can also be retained as executable behavior. Voyager accumulates reusable skills through interaction in Minecraft and retrieves them when solving later tasks [ 26 ] . This provides an example of organizing experience into computational tools.
paragraphs.zh: 经验也可以作为可执行的行为被保留下来。 Voyager 通过在《我的世界》中的互动积累可重复使用的技能，并在解决后续任务时调用这些技能 [ 26 ] 。 这为将经验组织成计算工具提供了一个示例。

sents.en: Experience can also be retained as executable behavior.
sents.zh: 经验也可以作为可执行的行为被保留下来。

sents.en: Voyager accumulates reusable skills through interaction in Minecraft and retrieves them when solving later tasks [ 26 ] .
sents.zh: Voyager 通过在《我的世界》中的互动积累可重复使用的技能，并在解决后续任务时调用这些技能 [ 26 ] 。

sents.en: This provides an example of organizing experience into computational tools.
sents.zh: 这为将经验组织成计算工具提供了一个示例。

paragraphs.en: These studies motivate examining how agents revisit information and use prior experience. Our Stop-and-report instruction encourages Codex to return when it encounters difficulty, after which the controller resumes the conversation with a goal reminder, without prescribing a separate critique-and-revision procedure. The AGI Maze comparison separately tests whether preceding tutorial experience benefits the unchanged agent.
paragraphs.zh: 这些研究促使我们探究智能体如何重新审视信息并利用过往经验。 我们的“停止并报告”指令鼓励 Codex 在遇到困难时返回，之后控制器会结合目标提醒继续对话，而不会规定单独的批评与修订流程。 AGI Maze 对比实验将单独测试先前的教程经验是否对未发生变化的智能体有益。

sents.en: These studies motivate examining how agents revisit information and use prior experience.
sents.zh: 这些研究促使我们探究智能体如何重新审视信息并利用过往经验。

sents.en: Our Stop-and-report instruction encourages Codex to return when it encounters difficulty, after which the controller resumes the conversation with a goal reminder, without prescribing a separate critique-and-revision procedure.
sents.zh: 我们的“停止并报告”指令鼓励 Codex 在遇到困难时返回，之后控制器会结合目标提醒继续对话，而不会规定单独的批评与修订流程。

sents.en: The AGI Maze comparison separately tests whether preceding tutorial experience benefits the unchanged agent.
sents.zh: AGI Maze 对比实验将单独测试先前的教程经验是否对未发生变化的智能体有益。

paragraphs.en: Research on test-time computation examines how model performance depends on the amount and organization of inference. Brown et al. study repeated sampling, showing that generating more candidate solutions increases the fraction of problems for which at least one correct solution is found; benefiting from this increase requires identifying a correct candidate [ 27 ] . Snell et al. investigate learned answer revision and verifier-guided search, finding that the relative effectiveness of inference strategies depends on problem difficulty [ 7 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 关于测试时计算的研究探讨了模型性能如何依赖于推理过程的数量和结构。 Brown 等人研究了重复采样，表明生成更多候选解会增加至少找到一个正确解的问题比例；要从中受益，需要能够识别出正确的候选解 [ 27 ] 。 Snell 等人研究了学习到的答案修正和验证器引导的搜索方法，发现推理策略的相对有效性取决于问题的难度 [ 7 ] 。

sents.en: Research on test-time computation examines how model performance depends on the amount and organization of inference.
sents.zh: 关于测试时计算的研究探讨了模型性能如何依赖于推理过程的数量和结构。

sents.en: Brown et al. study repeated sampling, showing that generating more candidate solutions increases the fraction of problems for which at least one correct solution is found; benefiting from this increase requires identifying a correct candidate [ 27 ] .
sents.zh: Brown 等人研究了重复采样，表明生成更多候选解会增加至少找到一个正确解的问题比例；要从中受益，需要能够识别出正确的候选解 [ 27 ] 。

sents.en: Snell et al. investigate learned answer revision and verifier-guided search, finding that the relative effectiveness of inference strategies depends on problem difficulty [ 7 ] .
sents.zh: Snell 等人研究了学习到的答案修正和验证器引导的搜索方法，发现推理策略的相对有效性取决于问题的难度 [ 7 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Computation can also be extended within a single reasoning process. In s1, Muennighoff et al. fine-tune a reasoning model and use budget forcing to control generation length, including prolonging a reasoning trace when the model attempts to finish [ 28 ] . This provides an example of how an intervention around stopping can change inference expenditure and performance.
paragraphs.zh: 计算也可以在单个推理过程中得到扩展。 在 s1 中，Muennighoff 等人对一种推理模型进行了微调，并利用预算强制手段来控制生成长度，包括在模型试图完成推理时延长推理轨迹 [ 28 ] 。 这提供了一个例子，说明围绕停止机制的干预如何能够改变推理的资源消耗和性能。

sents.en: Computation can also be extended within a single reasoning process.
sents.zh: 计算也可以在单个推理过程中得到扩展。

sents.en: In s1, Muennighoff et al. fine-tune a reasoning model and use budget forcing to control generation length, including prolonging a reasoning trace when the model attempts to finish [ 28 ] .
sents.zh: 在 s1 中，Muennighoff 等人对一种推理模型进行了微调，并利用预算强制手段来控制生成长度，包括在模型试图完成推理时延长推理轨迹 [ 28 ] 。

sents.en: This provides an example of how an intervention around stopping can change inference expenditure and performance.
sents.zh: 这提供了一个例子，说明围绕停止机制的干预如何能够改变推理的资源消耗和性能。

paragraphs.en: These studies motivate considering both how much inference an agent performs and how it is organized. In our study, Stop-and-report changes when Codex returns to an external controller, which resumes the conversation while the environment remains active. Even with the model and reasoning-effort setting fixed, this may change how long the agent continues working and when additional inference is used. We therefore examine inference expenditure as one possible contributor to the observed performance differences.
paragraphs.zh: 这些研究促使我们同时考虑智能体执行推理的多少以及推理的组织方式。 在我们的研究中，当 Codex 返回给外部控制器时，“停止并报告”机制会发生变化：外部控制器会恢复对话，而环境则保持活跃状态。 即使模型和推理努力程度设置固定不变，这一机制仍可能改变智能体持续工作的时长以及何时使用额外的推理。 因此，我们将推理消耗视为导致所观察到的性能差异的一个潜在因素进行考察。

sents.en: These studies motivate considering both how much inference an agent performs and how it is organized.
sents.zh: 这些研究促使我们同时考虑智能体执行推理的多少以及推理的组织方式。

sents.en: In our study, Stop-and-report changes when Codex returns to an external controller, which resumes the conversation while the environment remains active.
sents.zh: 在我们的研究中，当 Codex 返回给外部控制器时，“停止并报告”机制会发生变化：外部控制器会恢复对话，而环境则保持活跃状态。

sents.en: Even with the model and reasoning-effort setting fixed, this may change how long the agent continues working and when additional inference is used.
sents.zh: 即使模型和推理努力程度设置固定不变，这一机制仍可能改变智能体持续工作的时长以及何时使用额外的推理。

sents.en: We therefore examine inference expenditure as one possible contributor to the observed performance differences.
sents.zh: 因此，我们将推理消耗视为导致所观察到的性能差异的一个潜在因素进行考察。

paragraphs.en: EnvTraverse connects agents and environments through a common interaction contract. Each environment describes the task and how to interact with it, while the agent determines how to solve the task. The same agent can be connected to different environments without modification. New agents and environments can be integrated independently through the framework’s interfaces; agents need not use Codex or an LLM. Figure 1 summarizes the interaction contract.
paragraphs.zh: EnvTraverse 通过一个通用的交互契约将智能体与环境连接起来。 每个环境都会描述任务以及如何与之交互，而智能体则决定如何完成任务。 同一个智能体无需修改即可连接到不同的环境。 新的智能体和环境可以通过框架的接口独立集成；智能体无需使用 Codex 或 LLM。 图 1 总结了该交互契约。

sents.en: EnvTraverse connects agents and environments through a common interaction contract.
sents.zh: EnvTraverse 通过一个通用的交互契约将智能体与环境连接起来。

sents.en: Each environment describes the task and how to interact with it, while the agent determines how to solve the task.
sents.zh: 每个环境都会描述任务以及如何与之交互，而智能体则决定如何完成任务。

sents.en: The same agent can be connected to different environments without modification.
sents.zh: 同一个智能体无需修改即可连接到不同的环境。

sents.en: New agents and environments can be integrated independently through the framework’s interfaces; agents need not use Codex or an LLM.
sents.zh: 新的智能体和环境可以通过框架的接口独立集成；智能体无需使用 Codex 或 LLM。

sents.en: Figure 1 summarizes the interaction contract.
sents.zh: 图 1 总结了该交互契约。

paragraphs.en: The environment provides an environment description: text explaining the task, the goal to be achieved, and how the agent can interact with the environment. It may also provide supplementary files, such as documentation, helper programs, or initial observations, which are made available in the agent’s workspace. We treat these files as part of the environment description. The environment determines how much information about its rules and state the description provides.
paragraphs.zh: 环境会提供一个环境描述：一段解释任务、待实现目标以及智能体如何与环境交互的文本。 它也可能提供补充文件，例如文档、辅助程序或初始观察结果，这些文件会被放置在智能体的工作空间中。 我们将这些文件视为环境描述的一部分。 环境决定了该描述能提供多少关于其规则和状态的信息。

sents.en: The environment provides an environment description: text explaining the task, the goal to be achieved, and how the agent can interact with the environment.
sents.zh: 环境会提供一个环境描述：一段解释任务、待实现目标以及智能体如何与环境交互的文本。

sents.en: It may also provide supplementary files, such as documentation, helper programs, or initial observations, which are made available in the agent’s workspace.
sents.zh: 它也可能提供补充文件，例如文档、辅助程序或初始观察结果，这些文件会被放置在智能体的工作空间中。

sents.en: We treat these files as part of the environment description.
sents.zh: 我们将这些文件视为环境描述的一部分。

sents.en: The environment determines how much information about its rules and state the description provides.
sents.zh: 环境决定了该描述能提供多少关于其规则和状态的信息。

paragraphs.en: At each step, the agent submits an action encoded as JSON. The environment defines the valid action structures and their meaning. In response, it returns an observation consisting of an arbitrary set of named files. The contract does not prescribe their formats: observations may contain text, images, or other data. An action may also reference files in the agent’s designated workspace that are accessible to the server-side infrastructure.
paragraphs.zh: 在每一步中，智能体都会提交一个以 JSON 格式编码的动作。 环境定义了有效的动作结构及其含义。 作为响应，环境会返回一个观察结果，该结果由任意一组命名文件组成。 协议并未规定这些文件的格式：观察结果可能包含文本、图像或其他数据。 一个动作也可以引用智能体指定工作空间中服务器端基础设施可访问的文件。

sents.en: At each step, the agent submits an action encoded as JSON.
sents.zh: 在每一步中，智能体都会提交一个以 JSON 格式编码的动作。

sents.en: The environment defines the valid action structures and their meaning.
sents.zh: 环境定义了有效的动作结构及其含义。

sents.en: In response, it returns an observation consisting of an arbitrary set of named files.
sents.zh: 作为响应，环境会返回一个观察结果，该结果由任意一组命名文件组成。

sents.en: The contract does not prescribe their formats: observations may contain text, images, or other data.
sents.zh: 协议并未规定这些文件的格式：观察结果可能包含文本、图像或其他数据。

sents.en: An action may also reference files in the agent’s designated workspace that are accessible to the server-side infrastructure.
sents.zh: 一个动作也可以引用智能体指定工作空间中服务器端基础设施可访问的文件。

paragraphs.en: The environment decides when the interaction session ends and indicates this in its response. Once the session is terminal, no further actions are accepted. Termination does not necessarily indicate success; its meaning and the criteria for accomplishing the task are defined by the environment.
paragraphs.zh: 环境会决定互动会话何时结束，并在其响应中表明这一点。 一旦会话终止，将不再接受任何后续操作。 终止并不一定意味着成功；其含义以及完成任务的标准由环境定义。

sents.en: The environment decides when the interaction session ends and indicates this in its response.
sents.zh: 环境会决定互动会话何时结束，并在其响应中表明这一点。

sents.en: Once the session is terminal, no further actions are accepted.
sents.zh: 一旦会话终止，将不再接受任何后续操作。

sents.en: Termination does not necessarily indicate success; its meaning and the criteria for accomplishing the task are defined by the environment.
sents.zh: 终止并不一定意味着成功；其含义以及完成任务的标准由环境定义。

paragraphs.en: After initialization, interaction follows an agent-initiated request–response pattern: the environment does not send unsolicited observations. This restriction concerns communication, not whether the environment continues to evolve between requests.
paragraphs.zh: 初始化之后，交互遵循由智能体发起的请求-响应模式：环境不会发送未经请求的观察信息。 这一限制涉及通信方式，而非环境在请求之间是否持续演化。

sents.en: After initialization, interaction follows an agent-initiated request–response pattern: the environment does not send unsolicited observations.
sents.zh: 初始化之后，交互遵循由智能体发起的请求-响应模式：环境不会发送未经请求的观察信息。

sents.en: This restriction concerns communication, not whether the environment continues to evolve between requests.
sents.zh: 这一限制涉及通信方式，而非环境在请求之间是否持续演化。

paragraphs.en: The environment description, action semantics, observation formats, and termination rules are part of the environment specification. They are held fixed when comparing agents; changes to them define a new version of the environment specification.
paragraphs.zh: 环境描述、动作语义、观察格式和终止规则都是环境规范的一部分。 在比较智能体时，这些内容会被视为固定不变；对它们的任何修改都会定义一个新的环境规范版本。

sents.en: The environment description, action semantics, observation formats, and termination rules are part of the environment specification.
sents.zh: 环境描述、动作语义、观察格式和终止规则都是环境规范的一部分。

sents.en: They are held fixed when comparing agents; changes to them define a new version of the environment specification.
sents.zh: 在比较智能体时，这些内容会被视为固定不变；对它们的任何修改都会定义一个新的环境规范版本。

paragraphs.en: The implementation runs the agent and the environment server in separate Docker containers. Actions are JSON objects exchanged over HTTP, and responses carry observation files and terminal status. Initialization delivers the description text and an initial observation; supplementary files are placed in the agent’s workspace before interaction begins.
paragraphs.zh: 该实现将智能体与环境服务器运行在独立的 Docker 容器中。 动作是以 HTTP 协议交换的 JSON 对象，响应则包含观察文件和终端状态。 初始化阶段会提供描述文本和初始观察信息；在交互开始前，补充文件会被放置在智能体的工作空间中。

sents.en: The implementation runs the agent and the environment server in separate Docker containers.
sents.zh: 该实现将智能体与环境服务器运行在独立的 Docker 容器中。

sents.en: Actions are JSON objects exchanged over HTTP, and responses carry observation files and terminal status.
sents.zh: 动作是以 HTTP 协议交换的 JSON 对象，响应则包含观察文件和终端状态。

sents.en: Initialization delivers the description text and an initial observation; supplementary files are placed in the agent’s workspace before interaction begins.
sents.zh: 初始化阶段会提供描述文本和初始观察信息；在交互开始前，补充文件会被放置在智能体的工作空间中。

paragraphs.en: The server-side infrastructure can access the agent’s designated workspace, while the agent has no reciprocal direct access to the task implementation or task sandbox. Terminal-Bench uses this convention for send_path : the agent names a source file or directory and a destination, and the environment copies the requested contents (see Appendix A.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 服务器端基础设施可以访问智能体指定的工作区，而智能体则无法反向直接访问任务实现或任务沙盒。 Terminal-Bench 对 send_path 采用此约定：智能体指定一个源文件或目录以及一个目标位置，环境则会复制所请求的内容（参见附录 A.4）。

sents.en: The server-side infrastructure can access the agent’s designated workspace, while the agent has no reciprocal direct access to the task implementation or task sandbox.
sents.zh: 服务器端基础设施可以访问智能体指定的工作区，而智能体则无法反向直接访问任务实现或任务沙盒。

sents.en: Terminal-Bench uses this convention for send_path : the agent names a source file or directory and a destination, and the environment copies the requested contents (see Appendix A.4 ).
sents.zh: Terminal-Bench 对 send_path 采用此约定：智能体指定一个源文件或目录以及一个目标位置，环境则会复制所请求的内容（参见附录 A.4）。

paragraphs.en: In the evaluated setup, the agent container accesses the Internet only through an allowlisted proxy that permits connections to the domains needed by the LLM service. This restriction does not apply to the environment. An environment may use the Internet itself or provide Internet access to the agent through its actions. Evaluation-specific access controls are described in Section 7.3 . Implementation documentation is available through the EnvTraverse project page .
paragraphs.zh: 在受评估的配置中，智能体容器仅通过一个允许列表代理访问互联网，该代理只允许连接到 LLM 服务所需的域名。 此限制不适用于环境。 环境本身可以使用互联网，或者通过其操作为智能体提供互联网访问。 与评估相关的访问控制请参见第 7.3 节。 实现文档可通过 EnvTraverse 项目页面获取。

sents.en: In the evaluated setup, the agent container accesses the Internet only through an allowlisted proxy that permits connections to the domains needed by the LLM service.
sents.zh: 在受评估的配置中，智能体容器仅通过一个允许列表代理访问互联网，该代理只允许连接到 LLM 服务所需的域名。

sents.en: This restriction does not apply to the environment.
sents.zh: 此限制不适用于环境。

sents.en: An environment may use the Internet itself or provide Internet access to the agent through its actions.
sents.zh: 环境本身可以使用互联网，或者通过其操作为智能体提供互联网访问。

sents.en: Evaluation-specific access controls are described in Section 7.3 .
sents.zh: 与评估相关的访问控制请参见第 7.3 节。

sents.en: Implementation documentation is available through the EnvTraverse project page .
sents.zh: 实现文档可通过 EnvTraverse 项目页面获取。

paragraphs.en: We study one environment-agnostic agent in two prompt variants: Baseline ( agent_v1 ) and Stop-and-report ( agent_v1_01_wstop ). They use the same code, controller, and tools; only one short instruction differs. Each variant is deployed unchanged across environments for a given model–effort configuration. The agent simplifies the textual agent described in Section 4, “Architecture and Agent Variants,” of our earlier ARC-AGI-3 study [ 9 ] . We retain its Codex-based architecture while removing ARC-AGI-3-specific control and requirements to maintain a world model.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在两种提示变体中研究了一种与环境无关的智能体：Baseline（agent_v1）和 Stop-and-report（agent_v1_01_wstop）。 它们使用相同的代码、控制器和工具；只有简短的指令有所不同。 对于给定的模型–努力配置，每种变体都在所有环境中以未修改的形式部署。 该智能体简化了我们早期 ARC-AGI-3 研究 [9] 中第 4 节“架构与智能体变体”所描述的文本智能体。 我们保留了其基于 Codex 的架构，同时移除了 ARC-AGI-3 特定的控制机制和维持世界模型的要求。

sents.en: We study one environment-agnostic agent in two prompt variants: Baseline ( agent_v1 ) and Stop-and-report ( agent_v1_01_wstop ).
sents.zh: 我们在两种提示变体中研究了一种与环境无关的智能体：Baseline（agent_v1）和 Stop-and-report（agent_v1_01_wstop）。

sents.en: They use the same code, controller, and tools; only one short instruction differs.
sents.zh: 它们使用相同的代码、控制器和工具；只有简短的指令有所不同。

sents.en: Each variant is deployed unchanged across environments for a given model–effort configuration.
sents.zh: 对于给定的模型–努力配置，每种变体都在所有环境中以未修改的形式部署。

sents.en: The agent simplifies the textual agent described in Section 4, “Architecture and Agent Variants,” of our earlier ARC-AGI-3 study [ 9 ] .
sents.zh: 该智能体简化了我们早期 ARC-AGI-3 研究 [9] 中第 4 节“架构与智能体变体”所描述的文本智能体。

sents.en: We retain its Codex-based architecture while removing ARC-AGI-3-specific control and requirements to maintain a world model.
sents.zh: 我们保留了其基于 Codex 的架构，同时移除了 ARC-AGI-3 特定的控制机制和维持世界模型的要求。

paragraphs.en: Figure 2 shows the agent’s four components: a controller, a Codex coding agent, an environment-agnostic client, and a persistent Linux workspace. Codex performs the task-solving work: it reads observations, reasons about the task, writes and executes programs, and selects environment actions. It submits those actions through the provided client, which is part of the agent rather than the environment. The client provides the same interface across environments and contains no environment-specific logic.
paragraphs.zh: 图 2 展示了智能体的四个组成部分：一个控制器、一个 Codex 编码智能体、一个与环境无关的客户端，以及一个持久的 Linux 工作区。 Codex 负责任务解决工作：它读取观察结果，对任务进行推理，编写并执行程序，以及选择环境动作。 它通过所提供的客户端提交这些动作，该客户端是智能体的一部分，而非环境的一部分。 该客户端在不同环境中提供相同的接口，且不包含任何特定于环境的逻辑。

sents.en: Figure 2 shows the agent’s four components: a controller, a Codex coding agent, an environment-agnostic client, and a persistent Linux workspace.
sents.zh: 图 2 展示了智能体的四个组成部分：一个控制器、一个 Codex 编码智能体、一个与环境无关的客户端，以及一个持久的 Linux 工作区。

sents.en: Codex performs the task-solving work: it reads observations, reasons about the task, writes and executes programs, and selects environment actions.
sents.zh: Codex 负责任务解决工作：它读取观察结果，对任务进行推理，编写并执行程序，以及选择环境动作。

sents.en: It submits those actions through the provided client, which is part of the agent rather than the environment.
sents.zh: 它通过所提供的客户端提交这些动作，该客户端是智能体的一部分，而非环境的一部分。

sents.en: The client provides the same interface across environments and contains no environment-specific logic.
sents.zh: 该客户端在不同环境中提供相同的接口，且不包含任何特定于环境的逻辑。

paragraphs.en: The main prompt (Appendix B.1.1 ) asks Codex to read the environment description and accomplish the goal stated there. It explains how to invoke the client with a JSON action and where to find the resulting observations. The client saves the description, submitted actions, and returned files, and prints their locations. Observation records use a generic step-indexed layout rather than an environment-specific organization.
paragraphs.zh: 主提示（附录 B.1.1）要求 Codex 读取环境描述并完成其中陈述的目标。 它说明了如何使用 JSON 动作调用客户端，以及在哪里可以找到返回的观察结果。 客户端会保存环境描述、已提交的行动和返回的文件，并打印它们的位置。 观察记录使用通用的基于步骤的索引布局，而非特定于环境的组织结构。

sents.en: The main prompt (Appendix B.1.1 ) asks Codex to read the environment description and accomplish the goal stated there.
sents.zh: 主提示（附录 B.1.1）要求 Codex 读取环境描述并完成其中陈述的目标。

sents.en: It explains how to invoke the client with a JSON action and where to find the resulting observations.
sents.zh: 它说明了如何使用 JSON 动作调用客户端，以及在哪里可以找到返回的观察结果。

sents.en: The client saves the description, submitted actions, and returned files, and prints their locations.
sents.zh: 客户端会保存环境描述、已提交的行动和返回的文件，并打印它们的位置。

sents.en: Observation records use a generic step-indexed layout rather than an environment-specific organization.
sents.zh: 观察记录使用通用的基于步骤的索引布局，而非特定于环境的组织结构。

paragraphs.en: Codex can use files, the shell, Python, and supplied tools in its workspace. The main prompt asks it to use the workspace as it finds most effective and suggests helper indexes, access scripts, or reorganized copies of observations when useful, while prohibiting changes to the original observation records (Appendix B.1.1 ). It does not require a world model, planner, or verifier; Codex decides which additional files and tools to create. A single Codex invocation can include many model calls, local computations, and environment actions before returning control; it is not a single LLM call or environment step. The workspace and Codex conversation persist across ordinary continuations within a run.
paragraphs.zh: Codex 可以在其工作区中使用文件、外壳、Python 和提供的工具。 主要提示要求它按照最有效的方式使用工作区，并在必要时建议辅助索引、访问脚本或重新组织的观察副本，同时禁止修改原始观察记录（附录 B.1.1）。 它不需要世界模型、规划器或验证器；Codex 自行决定需要创建哪些附加文件和工具。 一次 Codex 调用可以在返回控制之前包含多次模型调用、本地计算和环境操作；它并非单次 LLM 调用或环境步骤。 工作区和 Codex 的对话在一次运行中的常规延续过程中会持续存在。

sents.en: Codex can use files, the shell, Python, and supplied tools in its workspace.
sents.zh: Codex 可以在其工作区中使用文件、外壳、Python 和提供的工具。

sents.en: The main prompt asks it to use the workspace as it finds most effective and suggests helper indexes, access scripts, or reorganized copies of observations when useful, while prohibiting changes to the original observation records (Appendix B.1.1 ).
sents.zh: 主要提示要求它按照最有效的方式使用工作区，并在必要时建议辅助索引、访问脚本或重新组织的观察副本，同时禁止修改原始观察记录（附录 B.1.1）。

sents.en: It does not require a world model, planner, or verifier; Codex decides which additional files and tools to create.
sents.zh: 它不需要世界模型、规划器或验证器；Codex 自行决定需要创建哪些附加文件和工具。

sents.en: A single Codex invocation can include many model calls, local computations, and environment actions before returning control; it is not a single LLM call or environment step.
sents.zh: 一次 Codex 调用可以在返回控制之前包含多次模型调用、本地计算和环境操作；它并非单次 LLM 调用或环境步骤。

sents.en: The workspace and Codex conversation persist across ordinary continuations within a run.
sents.zh: 工作区和 Codex 的对话在一次运行中的常规延续过程中会持续存在。

paragraphs.en: The controller is a small script that sends prompts and checks basic session state; it contains no task-solving logic. It follows the flow in Figure 3 . First, it initializes the environment through the client, then sends the main prompt, the variant-specific continuation instruction, and the initial client output identifying the description and observation files. Appendix B.2.3 gives the exact composition. The instruction distinguishing the variants is therefore present from the first invocation.
paragraphs.zh: 控制器是一个小型脚本，用于发送提示并检查基本的会话状态；它不包含任何任务解决逻辑。 它遵循图 3 中的流程。 首先，它通过客户端初始化环境，然后发送主提示、特定变体的续写指令，以及用于标识描述文件和观察文件的初始客户端输出。 附录 B.2.3 给出了确切的组成结构。 因此，区分各变体的指令从第一次调用时就已存在。

sents.en: The controller is a small script that sends prompts and checks basic session state; it contains no task-solving logic.
sents.zh: 控制器是一个小型脚本，用于发送提示并检查基本的会话状态；它不包含任何任务解决逻辑。

sents.en: It follows the flow in Figure 3 .
sents.zh: 它遵循图 3 中的流程。

sents.en: First, it initializes the environment through the client, then sends the main prompt, the variant-specific continuation instruction, and the initial client output identifying the description and observation files.
sents.zh: 首先，它通过客户端初始化环境，然后发送主提示、特定变体的续写指令，以及用于标识描述文件和观察文件的初始客户端输出。

sents.en: Appendix B.2.3 gives the exact composition.
sents.zh: 附录 B.2.3 给出了确切的组成结构。

sents.en: The instruction distinguishing the variants is therefore present from the first invocation.
sents.zh: 因此，区分各变体的指令从第一次调用时就已存在。

paragraphs.en: When Codex returns, the controller reads the terminal flag and latest environment-step index from saved client state. It does not interpret observations or assess Codex’s reasoning. If the environment is terminal, the controller exits; otherwise, it selects one of two protocols.
paragraphs.zh: 当 Codex 返回时，控制器会从保存的客户端状态中读取终端标志和最新的环境步索引。 它不会解释观察结果或评估 Codex 的推理过程。 如果环境处于终端状态，控制器将退出；否则，它会选择两种协议之一。

sents.en: When Codex returns, the controller reads the terminal flag and latest environment-step index from saved client state.
sents.zh: 当 Codex 返回时，控制器会从保存的客户端状态中读取终端标志和最新的环境步索引。

sents.en: It does not interpret observations or assess Codex’s reasoning.
sents.zh: 它不会解释观察结果或评估 Codex 的推理过程。

sents.en: If the environment is terminal, the controller exits; otherwise, it selects one of two protocols.
sents.zh: 如果环境处于终端状态，控制器将退出；否则，它会选择两种协议之一。

paragraphs.en: The controller resumes the same Codex conversation with a reminder to keep working toward the goal in the environment description (Appendix B.1.2 ), followed by the variant-specific instruction. The first nonterminal return receives this continuation even if the initial invocation took no action.
paragraphs.zh: 控制器恢复与 Codex 的相同对话，并提醒其继续朝着环境描述（附录 B.1.2）中的目标努力，随后给出特定变体的指令。 即使初始调用未采取任何行动，第一个非终端返回也会接收到这一延续。

sents.en: The controller resumes the same Codex conversation with a reminder to keep working toward the goal in the environment description (Appendix B.1.2 ), followed by the variant-specific instruction.
sents.zh: 控制器恢复与 Codex 的相同对话，并提醒其继续朝着环境描述（附录 B.1.2）中的目标努力，随后给出特定变体的指令。

sents.en: The first nonterminal return receives this continuation even if the initial invocation took no action.
sents.zh: 即使初始调用未采取任何行动，第一个非终端返回也会接收到这一延续。

paragraphs.en: If a continuation produces no new environment action, the controller adds the no-action reminder (Appendix B.1.3 ). If Codex again returns without taking an action, the controller exits. If the environment remains nonterminal, this exit triggers recovery, subject to the recovery limit described below. This is a fallback for repeated non-action.
paragraphs.zh: 如果续写过程没有产生任何新的环境动作，控制器将添加“无动作”提醒（附录 B.1.3）。 如果 Codex 再次返回而未采取任何动作，控制器将退出。 如果环境仍处于非终止状态，此退出操作将触发恢复机制，但需遵循下文描述的恢复限制。 这是针对重复无动作情况的一种备用方案。

sents.en: If a continuation produces no new environment action, the controller adds the no-action reminder (Appendix B.1.3 ).
sents.zh: 如果续写过程没有产生任何新的环境动作，控制器将添加“无动作”提醒（附录 B.1.3）。

sents.en: If Codex again returns without taking an action, the controller exits.
sents.zh: 如果 Codex 再次返回而未采取任何动作，控制器将退出。

sents.en: If the environment remains nonterminal, this exit triggers recovery, subject to the recovery limit described below.
sents.zh: 如果环境仍处于非终止状态，此退出操作将触发恢复机制，但需遵循下文描述的恢复限制。

sents.en: This is a fallback for repeated non-action.
sents.zh: 这是针对重复无动作情况的一种备用方案。

paragraphs.en: In our previous experiments, Codex occasionally exited with a runtime or service error, or appeared to freeze while its process remained alive but stopped producing observable activity [ 9 , Section 4.7, “Runtime recovery”] . Following that work, we use a recovery supervisor to continue execution after such failures.
paragraphs.zh: 在我们之前的实验中，Codex 偶尔会因运行时或服务错误而退出，或者在进程仍然存活但停止产生可观察活动时看似冻结 [9，第 4.7 节，“运行时恢复”]。 基于这项研究，我们使用一个恢复监督器在上述故障后继续执行。

sents.en: In our previous experiments, Codex occasionally exited with a runtime or service error, or appeared to freeze while its process remained alive but stopped producing observable activity [ 9 , Section 4.7, “Runtime recovery”] .
sents.zh: 在我们之前的实验中，Codex 偶尔会因运行时或服务错误而退出，或者在进程仍然存活但停止产生可观察活动时看似冻结 [9，第 4.7 节，“运行时恢复”]。

sents.en: Following that work, we use a recovery supervisor to continue execution after such failures.
sents.zh: 基于这项研究，我们使用一个恢复监督器在上述故障后继续执行。

paragraphs.en: The supervisor monitors the controller process and its activity log. When the process exits or the log remains inactive beyond the configured threshold, it restarts the controller if saved session state exists and the environment is still active. Recovery preserves the environment, workspace, and recorded observations. It normally resumes the saved Codex conversation, unlike the earlier implementation, which started a new conversation. 1 1 1 In our implementation, recovery starts a new Codex conversation if no environment action has yet been taken in the run; otherwise, it resumes the saved conversation. Implementation details are provided in the source code and documentation available through the EnvTraverse project page .
paragraphs.zh: 监督器会监控控制器进程及其活动日志。 当该进程退出或日志在超过配置阈值后仍无活动时，如果已保存会话状态且环境仍然活跃，它会重启控制器。 恢复过程会保留环境、工作空间和已记录的观察结果。 与早期版本（每次都会启动新对话）不同，本实现通常会恢复已保存的 Codex 对话。1 1 1 在我们的实现中，如果运行过程中尚未对环境执行任何操作，恢复时会启动新的 Codex 对话；否则，则会恢复已保存的对话。 实现细节可通过 EnvTraverse 项目页面获取的源代码和文档查看。

sents.en: The supervisor monitors the controller process and its activity log.
sents.zh: 监督器会监控控制器进程及其活动日志。

sents.en: When the process exits or the log remains inactive beyond the configured threshold, it restarts the controller if saved session state exists and the environment is still active.
sents.zh: 当该进程退出或日志在超过配置阈值后仍无活动时，如果已保存会话状态且环境仍然活跃，它会重启控制器。

sents.en: Recovery preserves the environment, workspace, and recorded observations.

sents.en: It normally resumes the saved Codex conversation, unlike the earlier implementation, which started a new conversation. 1 1 1 In our implementation, recovery starts a new Codex conversation if no environment action has yet been taken in the run; otherwise, it resumes the saved conversation.
sents.zh: 与早期版本（每次都会启动新对话）不同，本实现通常会恢复已保存的 Codex 对话。1 1 1 在我们的实现中，如果运行过程中尚未对环境执行任何操作，恢复时会启动新的 Codex 对话；否则，则会恢复已保存的对话。

paragraphs.en: As a consequence of the same restart rule, the supervisor also restarts the controller after an exit following the stuck reminder. It permits up to ten recovery attempts in total per environment run, after the initial launch. Ordinary Codex returns and normal continuations do not count against this allowance. The repeated opportunities after the stuck protocol are therefore a consequence of the recovery mechanism, whose main purpose is to handle technical Codex failures.
paragraphs.zh: 由于采用了相同的重启规则，在收到卡顿提醒后出现退出时，监督器也会重启控制器。 在初始启动之后，每个环境运行总共允许最多十次恢复尝试。 普通的 Codex 返回和正常续写不计入此配额限制。 因此，在卡顿协议之后提供的重复机会是恢复机制的结果，而该机制的主要目的是处理 Codex 的技术故障。

paragraphs.en: Consider a successful run in which Codex follows the Baseline instruction. The controller sends the initial message, and Codex carries out the task until the environment becomes terminal. Codex then returns and the controller exits. Neither the normal nor the stuck protocol is entered in this successful path: all task-solving work occurs within the initial Codex invocation. If Codex returns before termination despite this instruction, the controller prompts it to continue.
paragraphs.zh: 考虑一次成功的运行，其中 Codex 遵循了基线指令。 控制器发送初始消息，Codex 执行任务直到环境进入终止状态。 随后 Codex 返回，控制器退出。 在这条成功的路径中，既没有进入正常协议，也没有进入卡住协议：所有任务解决工作都发生在初始的 Codex 调用过程中。 如果 Codex 在此指令下在终止前返回，控制器会提示其继续执行。

paragraphs.en: The initial message instead asks Codex to return when it encounters a difficulty or uncertainty. If this happens before termination, the controller proceeds directly to the normal protocol and tells Codex to continue using the continuation text and the same Stop-and-report instruction. The conversation and workspace are retained. Here, “report it back to me” refers to the automated controller, not a human: the controller does not answer the report or supply a task-specific suggestion. Further returns follow the normal or stuck protocol described above. This variant can also finish the task without returning early.
paragraphs.zh: 初始消息则要求 Codex 在遇到困难或不确定性时返回。 如果这种情况发生在终止之前，控制器将直接进入正常协议，并指示 Codex 继续使用续写文本以及相同的“停止并报告”指令。 对话和工作区将被保留。 此处，“向我报告”指的是自动控制器，而非人类：控制器不会回应报告或提供与任务相关的建议。 后续的返回将遵循上述描述的正常协议或卡住协议。 这种变体也可以在未提前返回的情况下完成任务。

paragraphs.en: The intended difference is therefore when the same task-solving process returns control, not a change in its tools or environment-specific capabilities. paragraphs.en: We build environments from three existing benchmarks: ARC-AGI-3, a collection of interactive visual puzzles [ 11 ] ; AGI Maze, a framework of stateful grid labyrinths [ 12 ] ; and Terminal-Bench 2.1, a suite of practical command-line tasks [ 13 , 14 ] . 2 2 2 Project websites: ARC-AGI-3, https://arcprize.org/arc-agi/3 ; AGI Maze, https://agimaze.org/ ; Terminal-Bench 2.1, https://www.tbench.ai/news/terminal-bench-2-1 . Terminal-Bench provides a substantially different setting from the two game families: the agent works on files and programs in a task sandbox, and processes can continue executing between actions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从三个现有的基准测试中构建环境：ARC-AGI-3，即一系列交互式视觉谜题 [ 11 ]；AGI Maze，一个包含状态感知网格迷宫的框架 [ 12 ]；以及 Terminal-Bench 2.1，一套实用的命令行任务集 [ 13 , 14 ]。2 2 2 项目网站：ARC-AGI-3，https://arcprize.org/arc-agi/3；AGI Maze，https://agimaze.org/；Terminal-Bench 2.1，https://www.tbench.ai/news/terminal-bench-2-1。 Terminal-Bench 提供的环境与上述两个游戏系列截然不同：智能体在任务沙盒中处理文件和程序，并且各个动作之间进程可以持续执行。

paragraphs.en: The broad contract in Section 3 allows these different tasks to be exposed through the same interface. We distinguish the underlying benchmark from the environment defined for our experiments. An environment includes its environment description, comprising text and optional files; the dynamics that accept JSON actions, reject invalid requests, and return observation files; and its termination conditions. These choices define the environment, rather than merely documenting its implementation. Changing the ARC-AGI-3 description, omitting its PNG observations, or adding a direct exec action to Terminal-Bench would therefore produce a different environment specification, even with the same underlying task. Comparisons between agents keep the specification fixed.
paragraphs.zh: 第 3 节中宽泛的合同允许通过同一接口暴露这些不同的任务。 我们将底层基准与我们实验中定义的环境区分开来。 一个环境包括其环境描述（包含文本和可选文件）、接受 JSON 动作、拒绝无效请求并返回观察文件的动态机制，以及其终止条件。 这些选择定义了环境本身，而不仅仅是记录其实现方式。 因此，更改 ARC-AGI-3 的描述、省略其 PNG 观察结果，或向 Terminal-Bench 添加直接执行动作，即使底层任务相同，也会产生不同的环境规范。 智能体之间的比较会保持该规范的固定性。

paragraphs.en: The agent selects among the available game actions and receives the resulting visual frames and metadata. The full file inventory is given under “Provided Artifacts” in Appendix A.1 . The important representational choice is to provide each frame both as exact ASCII color-index data and as a corresponding PNG image, including intermediate frames when present. This lets the agent process the frame numerically or inspect it visually, consistent with the visual nature of the task. The initialization files also include ascii_to_png.py , which the agent can use to render reconstructed or transformed frames. Supplying only ASCII, with or without a rendering helper, would be another environment version; we do not compare those representations here.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体从可用的游戏动作中进行选择，并接收由此产生的视觉帧和元数据。 完整的文件清单在附录 A.1 的“提供的资源”部分给出。 重要的表示方式选择是，将每一帧同时以精确的 ASCII 颜色索引数据和对应的 PNG 图像形式提供，包括存在时的中间帧。 这使得智能体能够以数值方式处理该帧，或根据任务的视觉特性对其进行视觉检查。 初始化文件还包括 ascii_to_png.py，智能体可以使用它来渲染重建或转换后的帧。 仅提供 ASCII 数据（无论是否附带渲染辅助工具）会是另一种环境版本；我们在此不比较这些表示方式。

paragraphs.en: The environment ends at WIN or when the current-level action counter exceeds 1,500. The counter includes RESET actions, spans all attempts at the same level, and is cleared when a new level is reached. We use the 1,500-action threshold discussed in Section 5.4, “Interaction rules and stopping conditions,” of our earlier study [ 9 ] . That budget is an evaluation choice, not a native ARC-AGI-3 limit, and may restrict games requiring longer exploration. A larger budget could be used in an evaluation aimed at maximizing performance, but would change the environment specification.
paragraphs.zh: 环境在达到“胜利”状态或当前关卡的动作计数器超过 1,500 时结束。 该计数器包含“重置”动作，涵盖同一关卡的所有尝试，并在进入新关卡时清零。 我们采用了早期研究 [9] 的第 5.4 节“交互规则与停止条件”中讨论的 1,500 次动作阈值。 该预算是评估时的选择，而非 ARC-AGI-3 固有的限制，可能会限制需要更长时间探索的游戏。 在旨在最大化性能的评估中，可以使用更大的预算，但这将改变环境的定义。

sents.en: AGI Maze already supplies rules, task information, action identifiers, and textual feedback, so only a thin interface layer is needed.
sents.zh: AGI Maze 已经提供了规则、任务信息、动作标识符和文本反馈，因此只需要一个薄薄的接口层。

paragraphs.en: The environment description combines AGI Maze’s own rule description with the labyrinth’s public task information, available actions, and public map. All of this information is provided by AGI Maze. Appendix A.2 gives the full template and a rendered example.
paragraphs.zh: 环境描述结合了 AGI Maze 自身的规则说明、迷宫的公开任务信息、可用动作以及公开地图。 所有这些信息均由 AGI Maze 提供。 附录 A.2 提供了完整的模板和一个渲染示例。

sents.en: The environment description combines AGI Maze’s own rule description with the labyrinth’s public task information, available actions, and public map.
sents.zh: 环境描述结合了 AGI Maze 自身的规则说明、迷宫的公开任务信息、可用动作以及公开地图。

sents.en: All of this information is provided by AGI Maze.
sents.zh: 所有这些信息均由 AGI Maze 提供。

sents.en: Appendix A.2 gives the full template and a rendered example.
sents.zh: 附录 A.2 提供了完整的模板和一个渲染示例。

paragraphs.en: For tutorial labyrinths, the public map reveals all internal walls and features, including the positions of keys, treasure, rivers, and pits. We use tutorial labyrinths only in the curriculum-learning experiments with the labyrinth-set environment. For non-tutorial labyrinths, the public map shows only the external boundary and the player’s initial position, visualizing information already provided in the text.
paragraphs.zh: 对于教程迷宫，公开地图会显示所有内部墙壁和特征，包括钥匙、宝藏、河流和陷阱的位置。 我们仅在采用迷宫集环境的课程学习实验中使用教程迷宫。 对于非教程迷宫，公开地图仅显示外部边界和玩家的初始位置，即文本中已提供的信息。

sents.zh: 对于教程迷宫，公开地图会显示所有内部墙壁和特征，包括钥匙、宝藏、河流和陷阱的位置。

paragraphs.en: Actions encode the labyrinth-defined choices as JSON objects. After each action, the environment returns state.txt , containing textual feedback and inventory information.
paragraphs.zh: 动作将迷宫中定义的选择编码为 JSON 对象。 每次执行动作后，环境都会返回 state.txt，其中包含文本反馈和物品信息。

sents.zh: 每次执行动作后，环境都会返回 state.txt，其中包含文本反馈和物品信息。

paragraphs.en: The environment ends when the labyrinth is solved or the agent uses five times the max_steps reference budget provided by AGI Maze.
paragraphs.zh: 当迷宫被解开，或者智能体使用了 AGI Maze 提供的 max_steps 参考预算的五倍时，环境将结束。

paragraphs.en: One environment contains an ordered sequence of labyrinths. The agent remains in the same run throughout the sequence, allowing it to use experience from earlier labyrinths when solving later ones.
paragraphs.zh: 一个环境包含一系列有序的迷宫。 智能体在整个序列中始终处于同一运行状态，使其在解决后续迷宫时能够利用早期迷宫的经验。

sents.zh: 智能体在整个序列中始终处于同一运行状态，使其在解决后续迷宫时能够利用早期迷宫的经验。

paragraphs.en: The environment description asks the agent to solve all labyrinths efficiently and states that the first few are tutorials with an open map showing the player’s position; later maps are hidden. Appendix A.3.1 reproduces it verbatim.
paragraphs.zh: 环境描述要求智能体高效地解决所有迷宫，并指出前几个迷宫是教程，其地图是开放的，会显示玩家的位置；而后续的地图则是隐藏的。 附录 A.3.1 原样复现了该描述。

sents.en: Appendix A.3.1 reproduces it verbatim.

paragraphs.en: The agent starts each labyrinth with {"id":"start"} . The response includes labyrinth_description.md , containing the environment description used in the single-labyrinth setting, and state.txt , containing the same state information as in the single-labyrinth environment with the labyrinth index added. Tutorial labyrinths additionally return the current map and player position as map.txt ; non-tutorial labyrinths omit this file. This map is also supplied by AGI Maze.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体每次进入迷宫时都从 {"id":"start"} 开始。 响应中包括 labyrinth_description.md，其中包含单迷宫设置中使用的环境描述，以及 state.txt，其中包含与单迷宫环境相同的状态信息，并附加了迷宫索引。 教程迷宫还会额外返回当前地图和玩家位置作为 map.txt；非教程迷宫则不包含此文件。 AGI Maze 也会提供这张地图。

paragraphs.en: Each labyrinth receives the same fivefold action budget as in the single-labyrinth setting. Solving it or exhausting that budget produces message.md , reporting the outcome. When another labyrinth remains, the environment then waits for the next start action. This separates feedback about the previous labyrinth from initialization of the next. In particular, the failure message asks the agent to consider what went wrong before continuing. These messages are fixed environment inputs, and Appendix A.3.3 presents their exact text by the situation in which each is sent.
paragraphs.zh: 每个迷宫获得的五步行动预算与单迷宫设置中的相同。 解决该迷宫或耗尽该预算将生成 message.md，报告结果。 当另一个迷宫仍然存在时，环境会等待下一个开始动作。 这将前一个迷宫的反馈与下一个迷宫的初始化区分开来。 特别是，失败消息会要求智能体在继续之前考虑哪里出错了。 这些消息是固定的环境输入，附录 A.3.3 根据每条消息发送的具体情境给出了其确切文本。

paragraphs.en: The set ends only when the final labyrinth is solved or reaches its action limit. Failure on an earlier labyrinth does not terminate the set: the agent proceeds to the next one. A terminal set therefore means that the sequence is complete, not that every labyrinth was solved.
paragraphs.zh: 该集合仅在最后一个迷宫被解决或达到动作限制时才会结束。 在较早的迷宫中失败并不会终止该集合：智能体会继续进入下一个迷宫。 因此，终端集合意味着序列已经完成，而非所有迷宫都已被解决。

paragraphs.en: One environment contains a single Terminal-Bench task. Unlike the turn-based game settings, it can evolve while the agent deliberates. The task specifies a wall-clock time limit for solving.
paragraphs.zh: 一个环境包含单个 Terminal-Bench 任务。 与回合制游戏设置不同，该环境可以在智能体进行决策时不断演化。 该任务规定了完成求解的实时时间限制。

paragraphs.en: The environment description is generated from the template in Appendix A.4 , inserting the public task instruction as {instruction} and the solving budget in seconds as {budget} . The template gives the complete action interface and timing conventions. The environment description also explains that the task sandbox has a separate filesystem from the agent’s workspace and that task files are accessed through environment actions.
paragraphs.zh: 环境描述由附录 A.4 中的模板生成，其中将公共任务指令插入为 {instruction}，将解题预算时间（单位：秒）插入为 {budget}。 该模板提供了完整的动作接口和时序规范。 环境描述还说明，任务沙盒拥有独立于智能体工作区的文件系统，且任务文件需通过环境动作进行访问。

sents.zh: 环境描述还说明，任务沙盒拥有独立于智能体工作区的文件系统，且任务文件需通过环境动作进行访问。

paragraphs.en: The interface exposes six action categories. terminal_send submits literal text and named keys to an interactive terminal; terminal_read captures its screen or a bounded portion of its history; and terminal_new opens another independent shell on the same task filesystem. get_file retrieves a regular file, while send_path transfers a file or directory from the agent’s workspace to the task sandbox. Finally, finish submits the current task state and ends solving. Responses contain terminal snapshots, metadata, transfer acknowledgments, or retrieved file contents, depending on the action. Appendix A.4.1 lists the returned files.
paragraphs.zh: 该接口提供了六个操作类别。terminal_send 将原始文本和命名键提交给交互式终端；terminal_read 捕获其屏幕或历史记录的有限部分；而 terminal_new 则在同一任务文件系统上打开另一个独立的 shell。get_file 用于获取普通文件，而 send_path 则将文件或目录从智能体的工作区传输到任务沙盒中。 最后，finish 会提交当前任务状态并结束求解过程。 响应内容根据具体操作的不同，可能包含终端快照、元数据、传输确认信息或已获取的文件内容。 附录 A.4.1 列出了返回的文件。

sents.en: Appendix A.4.1 lists the returned files.
sents.zh: 附录 A.4.1 列出了返回的文件。

paragraphs.en: Terminal input does not wait for command completion. Processes continue between actions, and an empty or unchanged screen does not imply that a command has finished. A read may include a short fixed wait before capturing output, but it does not wait for a process to terminate. The agent must decide when to inspect output, send further input, interrupt a process, or work elsewhere. Thus, command execution is nonblocking with respect to completion, while observations are still delivered only in response to requests.
paragraphs.zh: 终端输入不会等待命令完成。 进程在动作之间持续运行，屏幕为空或没有变化并不意味着命令已经执行完毕。 读取操作可能在捕获输出前包含一个短暂的固定等待时间，但它不会等待进程终止。 智能体必须决定何时检查输出、发送更多输入、中断进程或转向其他任务。 因此，命令的执行在完成情况上是非阻塞的，而观察结果仍然仅在响应请求时才会提供。

sents.en: Terminal input does not wait for command completion.
sents.zh: 终端输入不会等待命令完成。

sents.zh: 进程在动作之间持续运行，屏幕为空或没有变化并不意味着命令已经执行完毕。

sents.zh: 智能体必须决定何时检查输出、发送更多输入、中断进程或转向其他任务。

sents.zh: 因此，命令的执行在完成情况上是非阻塞的，而观察结果仍然仅在响应请求时才会提供。

paragraphs.en: We do not expose a dedicated execute-and-wait action. This is an interface choice, not a restriction of Terminal-Bench: its evaluation infrastructure supports direct command execution by custom agents [ 29 ] . An exec action with a short waiting limit would also fit our contract, but would define another environment version. Whether it helps is outside this study. Here Terminal-Bench tests the unchanged agent in a setting markedly different from the games, rather than serving as an interface-optimization exercise.
paragraphs.zh: 我们并未提供一个专门的“执行并等待”动作。 这是一个接口设计的选择，而非 Terminal-Bench 的限制：其评估基础设施支持自定义智能体直接执行命令 [ 29 ] 。 一个带有较短等待时限的执行动作也符合我们的协议，但这将定义另一个环境版本。 它是否有帮助，超出了本研究的范围。 在此，Terminal-Bench 是在一个与游戏环境明显不同的设置中测试未修改的智能体，而非将其用作接口优化的练习。

paragraphs.en: Calling finish or reaching the task’s external timeout ends the solving phase and prevents further actions. In both cases, the verifier is run and its reward determines the task score; successful verification can therefore receive reward 1 after an agent timeout. If the verifier itself times out, the score is zero. Termination and task success remain distinct: calling finish is not itself evidence that the task was solved.
paragraphs.zh: 调用 finish 或达到任务的外部超时时间会结束求解阶段，并阻止后续操作。 在这两种情况下，都会运行验证器，其奖励值将决定任务得分；因此，在智能体超时后，成功验证可获得奖励值 1。 如果验证器本身出现超时，则得分为零。 终止与任务成功仍然是两个不同的概念：调用 finish 本身并不能证明任务已被解决。

paragraphs.en: These experiments investigate why an ARC-AGI-3-specific scaffold can outperform the general agent when the relevant environment information is already available to both. We first compare against twma_v1.61 , the updated textual agent from our earlier study, whose specialization primarily concerns how information is organized and how the interaction is controlled. Because that comparison involves several differences, we also evaluate a separate variant, Controlled_RESET, which adds an ARC-AGI-3-specific reset policy to Stop-and-report. Both diagnostic systems are evaluated only on ARC-AGI-3, at the same model–effort configurations as the environment-agnostic variants.
paragraphs.zh: 这些实验旨在探究：当相关环境信息对双方均已可用时，为何一个专为 ARC-AGI-3 设计的框架能够超越通用智能体。 我们首先与 twma_v1.61 进行比较，这是我们在先前研究中改进的文本型智能体，其专业化主要体现在信息组织方式与交互控制机制上。 由于该比较涉及多个差异，我们还评估了一个独立变体 Controlled_RESET，它向 Stop-and-report 添加了一项专为 ARC-AGI-3 设计的重置策略。 这两种诊断系统仅在 ARC-AGI-3 上进行评估，且采用与环境无关的变体相同的模型与努力配置。

sents.en: These experiments investigate why an ARC-AGI-3-specific scaffold can outperform the general agent when the relevant environment information is already available to both.
sents.zh: 这些实验旨在探究：当相关环境信息对双方均已可用时，为何一个专为 ARC-AGI-3 设计的框架能够超越通用智能体。

sents.en: We first compare against twma_v1.61 , the updated textual agent from our earlier study, whose specialization primarily concerns how information is organized and how the interaction is controlled.
sents.zh: 我们首先与 twma_v1.61 进行比较，这是我们在先前研究中改进的文本型智能体，其专业化主要体现在信息组织方式与交互控制机制上。

sents.en: Because that comparison involves several differences, we also evaluate a separate variant, Controlled_RESET, which adds an ARC-AGI-3-specific reset policy to Stop-and-report.
sents.zh: 由于该比较涉及多个差异，我们还评估了一个独立变体 Controlled_RESET，它向 Stop-and-report 添加了一项专为 ARC-AGI-3 设计的重置策略。

sents.en: Both diagnostic systems are evaluated only on ARC-AGI-3, at the same model–effort configurations as the environment-agnostic variants.
sents.zh: 这两种诊断系统仅在 ARC-AGI-3 上进行评估，且采用与环境无关的变体相同的模型与努力配置。

paragraphs.en: twma_v1.61 retains the textual agent, twma_v1.6 , described in Section 4, “Architecture and Agent Variants,” of our earlier study [ 9 ] . Its task-solving prompts and controller logic are unchanged. We update Codex to version 0.154.0 and use the same runtime memory safeguards as the environment-agnostic agents in this study. 3 3 3 The earlier ulimit -v 6000000 is replaced by Docker settings --memory 10g , --memory-swap 10g , and --ulimit data=2147483648:2147483648 . The reference is rerun in the present campaign rather than represented by historical scores.
paragraphs.zh: twma_v1.61 保留了文本智能体 twma_v1.6，该智能体在我们早期研究 [9] 的第 4 节“架构与智能体变体”中有详细描述。 其任务解决提示和控制器逻辑均未改变。 我们将 Codex 更新到版本 0.154.0，并使用与本研究中的环境无关智能体相同的运行时内存保护机制。3 3 3 早期的 ulimit -v 6000000 已被 Docker 设置 --memory 10g、--memory-swap 10g 和 --ulimit data=2147483648:2147483648 所取代。 参考模型在当前实验中重新运行，而非通过历史分数来表示。

sents.en: Its task-solving prompts and controller logic are unchanged.
